{{Quote|&hellip;Baris, Red, Kef&hellip;|Skirata and Vau mention Red in their mourning|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
'''Red''' was the nickname of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was born and trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, Red was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the war,<ref name="Order 66" /> which took place between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Order 66" /><ref name="TNEC" /> Along with many other clone [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] who had been killed in action, Red was later mourned by the Mandalorian training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] [[Kal Skirata]] and [[Walon Vau]].<ref name="Order 66" />

==Personality and traits==
Like his clone imprint,<ref name="clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> Jango Fett, Red was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Red was first mentioned in [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], a novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2009]]. ''Order 66'' is the fourth and final novel in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]].<ref name="Order 66" />
